question: Who received the prestigious Sanjay Gandhi Prize in Environment and Ecology in 1984 for demonstrating ecological differentiation and ecosystem hypothesis in the light of tropical vegetation of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramdeo Misra**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramdeo Misra **received the prestigious **Sanjay Gandhi Prize in Environment and Ecology in 1984 **for demonstrating ecological differentiation and ecosystem hypothesis in light of the tropical vegetation of India.
 
• He gave a great contribution to the field of Ecology.
 
• He is known as the **Father of Indian Ecology**.
 
• He taught ecology at **Banaras Hindu University **and started a **postgraduate course in Ecology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He was conferred with many awards like **Jawaharlal Nehru Gold Meda, Sanjay Gandhi Award for Environment and Ecology, Swami Pranavanand Saraswati Award, and many more**.
 
• **Ecology** is the study of the relationships between **living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment**; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them

 Distinguished **Professor of Biology at the University of Massachusetts Boston**, and Founder-President of the Ashoka Trust for Research in Ecology and the Environment (ATREE)
